full_text:
Shifter is a Draco-Titan whose appearance is that of a majestic carnival mask with a ghostly purple cape. With exceptional shape-shifting abilities, Shifter's Amulet is in the possession of Ryder.

History

During the Carnival in Venice, Italy, Shifter was used to change Belgrieve's form into that of Ryder. Whilst fighting Dante Vale, the mask was kicked off and Belgrieve was revealed. [The Carnival of Deception]

Abilities

Shifter is able to shape-shift and can manifest itself in a ghostly phantom. It can also fly. It can also become a mask and change its wearer's form.
